function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limits page | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | TxDOT – Cell Phone Use | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Yield” signs give priority to the vehicle already in the intersection. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not pass on the right unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | TxDOT – Lane‑Changing | | **School Bus** | • Stop when a school bus is stopped with its red lights flashing and stop sign extended.
• Vehicles may not pass the bus until the lights are off. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, 15 ft of a stop sign, or 30 ft of a railroad crossing.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited. | TxDOT – Parking Rules | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Vehicles may be towed for illegal parking, obstruction, or safety hazards.
• Towed vehicles must be removed within 24 hrs or face additional penalties. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) – Vehicle Registration | | **Insurance** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | TxDMV – Insurance Requirements | | **Special Situations** | • **High‑way Exit & Merge**: Use the “exit lane” and signal early.
• **Construction Zones**: Follow posted signs and reduced speed limits. | TxDOT – Construction Safety | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT Website**: Regular updates on road conditions, construction, and new regulations. - **TxDMV**: For registration, insurance, and driver’s license information. - **Texas Transportation Code**: The legal text governing all traffic laws. - **Local County Courts**: For specific local ordinances that may add to state law. --- #### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always keep your seat belt fastened.** 2. **Avoid distractions** – no texting or handheld phone use. 3. **Observe posted speed limits** – they’re there for safety. 4. **Yield to pedestrians** and school buses. 5. **Check your insurance** – it’s mandatory and protects you and others. If you need more detailed information on a specific law or want to check the latest updates, let me know!
